proof_body:
by
  intro f c hf hfr
  have hne : meromorphicOrderAt f c ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    rw [meromorphicOrderAt_eq_top_iff] at h
    exact hfr (h.mono (fun z hz => not_not.mpr hz))
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hne
  refine ⟨n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [smul_eq_mul] using (meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff hf).mp hn.symm
  · rintro m ⟨g, hg, hg0, he⟩
    have : meromorphicOrderAt f c = m := (meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff hf).mpr ⟨g, hg, hg0, by simpa [smul_eq_mul] using he⟩
    rw [← hn] at this
    exact_mod_cast this.symm
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ), MeromorphicAt f c → (∃ᶠ z in nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ, f z ≠ 0) → ∃! n : ℤ, ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ g c ∧ g c ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ, f z = (z - c) ^ n * g z
